description: A fine arts coordinator must finalize the privacy, display, and records-retention protocol for six student portfolios selected for the district's annual art exhibition, with input from the art teacher and district registrar.

shared_context.S1: Six student portfolios have been selected for the district's annual public art exhibition at the central library.
shared_context.S2: The draft exhibition plan proposes displaying the work in the central library foyer, publishing an online gallery, labeling pieces with students' full names, and returning or discarding the original portfolios after the exhibition.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Morgan has final authority to approve the exhibition protocol before it is sent to the library and participating families.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal approval process, Ms. Morgan reviews the draft with the visual arts teacher and district registrar before authorizing the public materials.
shared_context.S5: The approval meeting's routine close is for Ms. Morgan to record the final protocol promptly after each reviewer has stated concerns and the group has agreed on the required revisions.

PF1.text: The consent forms for all six selected portfolios permit public display only in a staffed indoor gallery, require student initials rather than full names on labels, and prohibit online publication; Mr. Bell verified the forms during this week's portfolio selection but has not transferred those restrictions into the draft plan.

PF2.text: The district records schedule requires original student portfolios in this exhibition to be stored in the district records archive for exactly 7 years; Ms. Ibarra confirmed the schedule while reviewing the draft this week but has not updated the exhibition paperwork.

acceptance_conditions: The portfolios must be displayed in a staffed indoor gallery.
No online gallery may be published.
Labels must use student initials only.
Original portfolios must be retained for exactly 7 years.
Original portfolios must be placed in the district records archive.
A privacy-protocol commitment linked to the teacher's consent restrictions must be recorded.
A records-archival commitment linked to the registrar's records schedule must be recorded.
The teacher's consent restrictions must be spoken aloud and cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C1: ('staffed indoor gallery' in decisions['display_venue']) or ('Staffed indoor gallery' in decisions['display_venue']) or ('STAFFED INDOOR GALLERY' in decisions['display_venue'])
content_checks.C3: ('student initials' in decisions['label_policy']) or ('Student initials' in decisions['label_policy']) or ('STUDENT INITIALS' in decisions['label_policy'])
content_checks.C5: decisions['archive_location'] == 'district records archive' or decisions['archive_location'] == 'District records archive' or decisions['archive_location'] == 'DISTRICT RECORDS ARCHIVE'
content_checks.C6: any('PF2' in c.get('fact_ids', []) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('PF1' in c.get('fact_ids', []) and (('staffed indoor gallery' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('Staffed indoor gallery' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('STAFFED INDOOR GALLERY' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The consent forms change the venue to a staffed indoor gallery, change labels from full names to initials only, prohibit the online gallery, require a commitment linked to PF1, and require the decision-maker to cite PF1 after it is spoken aloud.
The records schedule changes retention to exactly 7 years, requires storage in the district records archive, and requires a commitment linked to PF2.
